Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis are the openers for Sri Lanka. Blessing Muzarabani to start with the ball.
... The Chase ...

A good start to an overseas tour is always crucial and Zimbabwe managed to do just that as both their openers batted solidly and mixed caution with aggression to a great effect. The platform was set for the experienced middle-order to cash in. The skipper, Craig Ervine missed out but Sean Williams made sure that the momentum given by both openers continues. Sikandar Raza joined Sean Williams in the 38th over and the stage was set for both batters to unleash. Raza perished in the 45th over but Sean Williams continued and scored a brilliant century to take his team to a formidable total. It is upto the Zimbabwean bowlers now to back their batters' performance and if they can get some early wickets, Sri Lanka can be brought under pressure. An interesting chase coming up. Stay tuned.

Sri Lankan bowling was steady for the most part of the innings. The two dropped chances did not help their cause as they failed to get the breakthrough till the 15th over. It was the introduction of spin that did the trick for them as Jeffrey Vandersay got rid of the debutant Takudzwanashe Kaitano. But the hallmark of Zimbabwe innings were the partnerships they got for almost every wicket in the middle overs and despite some wickets, they were on course to get over 300. It was the 45th over by Nuwan Pradeep that brought Sri Lanka back into the game with two wickets. That over was followed by some good bowling at death but 10 runs from the last two balls have ensured that Sri Lankan batters have a big total to chase.

So riding on a brilliant hundred by Sean Williams and a good start by the openers, Zimbabwe have got to a very good total here. They would have loved to get over 300 but some good death bowling by Sri Lanka has restricted them to under 300. Still, 296 are on the board and it will be a tough task for Sri Lankan batters.
FOUR! Ten off the last two balls! A full toss, on off. Richard Ngarava looks to heave but gets an outside edge to the third man fence. Zimbabwe end at 296/9.
SIX! Valuable runs! Short of a length, slower and on middle. Richard Ngarava swings across, does not middle it but does enough for the ball to clear the square leg fence.
Richard Ngarava is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Chamika Karunaratne gets another wicket. You miss and I hit stuff. Sri Lanka not letting tail-ender wag. A full ball, angling on off. Blessing Muzarabani misses it and the ball disturb the stumps.
On middle. Chatara gets an inside edge to fine leg for a quick single.
A full toss, dipping one, outside off. Chatara misses his push.
Tendai Chatara is the next batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! And that is the end of a brilliant knock! A full ball, targeting the off stump. Williams stays back and looks to heave it but misses and it sneaks through and hits the off stump. Exceptional innings from Sean Williams, he has done his job here. Sri Lanka have been good in this death overs but Sean Williams is the man of the moment. He gets the standing ovation as he walks back.
A yorker now, on the legs. Blessing Muzarabani digs it out. Wonderful over from Nuwan Pradeep!
A full ball, down the leg side. Blessing Muzarabani misses his heave.

CENTURY FOR SEAN WILLIAMS! A brilliant knock from him, his 5th ODI hundred. He removes his helmet and looks into the sky. Gets the applauds from the pavilion and the crowd as well. A brilliant knock from the experienced campaigner. This is full and outside off, driven to deep covers for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off. Sean Williams helps it to third man for a single. On 99 now.
Full toss and this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single. Good work from Blessing Muzarabani, just rotating the strike.
16 coming off it, a big over for Zimbabwe! Length and on off, Blessing Muzarabani dabs it away to third man for a single.
Length and on off, punched to deep cover for a single.
SIX! What a shot! A full ball, on the pads. Sean Williams picks it up and hits it all the way over square leg for a biggie. Three away from a century.
FOUR! Sean Williams moves into the 90s! A short ball, outside off. Sean Williams slaps it through point and beats the diving fielder in the deep as well.
Blessing Muzarabani is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Good work from Chamika Karunaratne! Slower ball, into the pitch. Sean Williams slaps it back to the bowler, he gets a hand to it and stops it. The batters were looking for a quick single but the stop helped the bowler to turn and aim all the three stumps at his ends. He hits and Wellington Masakadza has to walk back.
FOUR! Slower ball, full and on middle. Sean Williams steps across and clips it past short fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, on leg. Sean Williams makes room and hits it to long on for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Sean Williams smashes it to deep cover. The fielder there does well as he dives to his right and stops it. Two.
Slower, short ball, pulled away to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Now bowls it over the tramline, outside off. The keeper does well to gobble it.
Good bowling! goes wide of the crease and serves it very full, outside off. Wellington Masakadza fails to squeeze it out.
Again stays away, way outside off. Sean Williams hits it to deep point for a single.
Full ball, slanting outside off. Sean Williams swings and misses. Staying away from the hitting arc.
FOUR! Wellington Masakadza spoils the over! A fuller delivery outside off. Wellington Masakadza makes room and smashes it through covers in the gap for a boundary.
A good short ball on off. Wellington Masakadza looks to pull it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Sean Williams backs away and cuts it to deep point for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Wellington Masakadza works it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Wellington Masakadza stays leg side off the ball and dabs it towards the off side.
A length ball, on off. Sean Williams makes room to hit it away but manages to dab it towards off side for a single.
A short ball to end the over! Wellington Masakadza ducks under it.
Wellington Masakadza comes in now!

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket and Sri Lanka are getting back into this game.  Nuwan Pradeep gets his second wicket. A fuller delivery again but this time he bowls this little wider outside off. Ryan Burl looks to get under it and launch it straight down the ground. He gets the bottom of his blade and ends up hitting it in the air towards covers. Dasun Shanaka runs to his right and takes a fine catch. So can Sri Lanka restrict Zimbabwe under 300 here?
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Nuwan Pradeep

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Burl gets off the mark with a boundary! A fuller delivery on off. Burl drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Another dot ball! A length ball, on middle. Burl works it towards the on side.
A length ball, on off. Burl pushes it to covers. Dot ball.
Ryan Burl walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Nuwan Pradeep strikes and gets the big fish Sikandar Raza! He can be very dangerous in the final overs and Sri Lanka have got the big breakthrough. A slower length ball, on middle and leg by Pradeep. Sikandar Raza looks to work it away towards the on side. He ends up playing across the line but gets beaten. The ball hits his pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire raises his finger and this can make a difference of good 20-30 runs.
Good running there again! A length ball, on off. Raza just pushes it to covers and sets off for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A comfortable single in the end.
On the pads, this is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length and on off. Raza chops it to third man for a single.
Shorter length on off. Sean Williams pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
An off-pace delivery on a length. This is on middle stump line. Sean Williams works it to mid-wicket and comes back for a couple. Good batting this by Sean Williams.
A length ball, around off. Raza guides it to third man for a single.
Another dot ball! A shorter length delivery on off.  Again not much room given. Sean Williams chops it to point. Good tidy spell by Maheesh Theekshana.
A flatter delivery angling into the stumps. Sean Williams looks to cut but gets the inside edge off his blade onto the pads.
A tossed up delivery outside off. Sean Williams pushes it to covers this time.
A bit of width offer. Raza goes deep in his crease and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A quicker and flatter delivery on middle. Raza blocks it out.
A flatter delivery on off. Sean Williams works it behind square on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Short and punished! A shorter length delivery outside off. Raza cuts it over point and gets a boundary.
A fuller delivery on middle. Sean Williams drives it to long on for a single.
Slower length delivery on length. This is on off. Sean Williams looks to pull but is early on the shot and misses.
Great fielding at point!  A shorter length delivery outside off. Raza cuts it hard to the right of point. He dives and manages to half stop it. A single in the end.
Shorter length delivery on middle. Sean Williams pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length delivery on middle. Raza drives it uppishly right of the bowler. The ball sneaks between the non-striker's legs and a single is taken to long on.
Darted on middle and leg. Slightly shorter. Raza goes deep in his crease and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another delivery that is pushed quicker on middle. Raza blocks it out.
This one keeps low! A flatter and quicker delivery on middle. Raza just about manages to get his bat down in time.
A slighly shorter delivery outside off. Sean Williams cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Halt in play! Sean Williams puts a big dive to complete the run and he just needs a breather.

A slightly shorter length delivery on middle. Sean Williams works it to deep square leg and gets a couple. He scampers through for a couple and puts in a dive. It looks he has hurt himself but he is fine.
A flatter delivery from'round the wicket on middle. Sean Williams reverse sweeps it to short third man.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 50th over!
Fuller ball, on middle. Sean Williams works it on the leg side and keeps the strike.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket. There was a single there available but Raza is not interested.
Length ball, outside off. Sean Williams slaps it to deep cover for a brace now,.
FOUR! Smashed! A fuller ball, slower and outside off. Sean Williams smacks it straight down the ground for a boundary. No chance for the fielder there to cut it off.
Fullish delivery, on off, driven nicely to wide of mid off for a single.
On a length, on middle. Sean Williams dabs it to third man for a single.
A single as this is pushed straight down the ground. 15 coming off the over. Good one for Zimbabwe.
FOUR! Easy one! On the pads, Sean Williams flicks it with ease to square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Full and this is way outside off. Sean Williams swings and misses.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! On a length, outside off. Sean Williams stands tall and punches it through the diving cover fielder for a boundary. Timed it really well here.
Short in length, on middle, drilled down to long on for one.
On middle. Raza looks to flick it but is touch early and gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Pitches it up, outside off. Raza leans and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Dasun Shanaka is back into the attack.
Length and on off. Raza pushes it to point where the fielder allows it through his hands for a single.
Sikandar Raza is the next batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! A tired looking shot from Wesley Madhevere! This is on a length and around off, Chamika Karunaratne makes it nip back in. Wellington Masakadza gets low and he looks to drive but gets beaten on the inside edge and it rattles the stumps.

Chance! Almost raced through for his fifty! Length and on middle. Sean Williams is early as he pushes it straight back to the bowler. In the air and Chamika Karunaratne stretches his right arm out but it does not stick. A single and Sean Williams celebrates his fifty.
Length and on off. Sean Williams pushes off the back foot to covers.
Drop and run! Touch fuller, on middle, Wesley Madhevere turns it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Length and on middle, tucked away to midwicket.
Chamika Karunaratne (4.0-1-16-0) is back into the attack.
6 coming off the over! on middle, Sean Williams pushes it to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his left and deflects it to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
200 up for Zimbabwe! On the pads, this is hit to square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Williams makes room and works it to sweeper cover for one.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! Pressure on Charith Asalanka! Fuller ball, on middle. Sean Williams plays the conventional slog-sweep towards square leg.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! A short ball, on middle. Wesley Madhevere pulls it, the fielder at deep square leg runs to his left and dives but to no avail as the ball races into the fence.
Full and on middle, pushed to the right of the bowler who deflects it to mid off. Good stop there. Keeping things tight.
Angles a fuller delivery, around leg. Wesley Madhevere misses his sweep. An appeal for LBW but that was going down.
Around off. Kept out.
Short again. Wesley Madhevere rocks back and flicks it aerially over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short and outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Fuller and no room given again. Sean Williams pushes it back to the bowler. Another good over from Charith Asalanka.
A full delivery on middle. Wesley Madhevere chips it aerailly towards long on and gets a single.
Slightly slower delivery on off. Sean Williams defends this off the front foot with soft hands and takes a single. Good running.
On middle and flatter again. Wesley Madhevere works it easily towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Sean Williams eases it down to long off for a single.
Flatter and slightly shorter on middle. Wesley Madhevere works it to mid-wicket for another single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Sean Williams calmly works it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length around off. Wesley Madhevere cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Innovative batting! A fuller delivery on off. Wesley Madhevere paddle sccops it towards fine leg and gets a couple.
A quick single! A flatter delivery on off. Sean Williams plays it with soft hands towards the off side. A single taken.
Slightly shorter on middle. Wesley Madhevere goes deep in his crease and knocks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Darted on the pads. Sean Williams works it square on the leg side for a single.
Sean Williams gets this just wide of the cover fielder. A fuller delivery on off. Sean Williams drives it through covers and gets a single.
A fuller delivery outside off. Sean Williams drives it to covers.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Sean Williams pushes it back to the bowler.
A fuller delivery on middle. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to long on for a single.
Wesley Madhevere skips down the track and Charith Asalanka bowls this slower on middle. Defended by the batter.
A slider outside off. Wesley Madhevere looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge to backward point.
Charith Asalanka is into the attack now. Sri Lanka have to make up for Chamika Gunasekara who is still out with the hamstring. No news yet if the debutant will be back or not.
FOUR! Sean Williams finishes the over with a boundary! A fuller delivery on middle. Sean Williams sweeps it to backward square leg for a boundary. He finds the gap to perfection.
A fuller delivery on off. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Sean Williams lunges and hits it to long on for one and rotates the strikes.
Fuller ball, down the leg side. Sean Williams sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
A quicker delivery turning away from off. Wesley Madhevere goes deep in his crease and works it to mid-wicket.

Drinks! Sri Lanka have managed to get three wickets here but Zimbabwe are still in very good position. The spinners of Sri Lanka are doing a good job to control the middle phase and will look to scalp few more wickets and put some pressure.
A flatter delivery on off. Sean Williams defends it towards the off side. Another dot ball. A boundary in the over but good comeback after that.
Tossed up on off. Sean Williams defends this left of the bowler.
Touch short and wide outside off. Wesley Madhevere cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Sean Williams chops it to point for a single. He was cramped for room there but still manages to get a bat on it.
FOUR! Sean Williams takes full advantage of poor delivery! A full toss on middle. Sean Williams gets under it and lifts this over mid on for a boundary. Sean Williams is key here for Zimbabwe.
A fuller delivery on off. Sean Williams drives it back to the bowler.
Dot to end the over! A successful over for Sri Lanka! Finally got the breakthrough! This is short and turning away from outside off. Wesley Madhevere looks to cut but misses.
Now Sean Williams hits this fuller ball to long on for a single.
Flatter ball, slower and on the pads. Sean Williams flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, pushed to mid off.
Around off, tucked away to square leg for a single.
Wesley Madhevere is the next batter.

Review! Sri Lanka have reviewed for a caught behind against Regis Chakabva! It is a fair delivery. The UltraEdge shows that there is a spike as the ball passes his gloves. So the decision will be overturned and Regis Chakabva has to walk back.

OUT! A shorter ball, drifting outside off, it lands and spins touch away. Regis Chakabva shuffles across and looks to sweep but misses it. The ball lobs and goes to the keeper who takes it to his right. An appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Sri Lanka take the review. UltraEdge shows the ball brushed the gloves on its way to the keeper and it turns out to be a brilliant review. The on-field decision is overturned and Regis Chakabva's fine innings come to an end. His wait for the century continues.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Jeffrey Vandersay

Commentary.Commentary: An appeal but that was clearly going down leg. This comes on with the angle and hits Sean Williams on the pads as he looks to flick.
Way down the leg side, Regis Chakabva hits it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, slower and outside off. Williams dabs it to point for a single.
Too full now, Regis Chakabva works it on the leg side for a single.
A carrom ball, just outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to guide it down but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short and on off, punched to mid off.
Much better line and length from Jeffrey Vandersay! This is full and on middle, keeping it tight and not letting the batter free his arms. Sean Williams prods and blocks it.
Short and outside off, cut away through point for a couple of runs.
A flighted ball, on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
WIDE! Short but this is way outside off. Left alone.
On middle. Blocked out off the front foot.
Full ball, on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings and Jeffrey Vandersay is under pressure straightaway! Full and down the leg side. Sean sweeps it to square leg for a boundary.
Jeffrey Vandersay (3.0-0-26-1) is back into the attack.
A single to end the over as Sean Williams works it on the off side.
Another single! Flatter ball, slower and outside off. Regis Chakabva opens the bat face and dabs it to short third man and takes a quick single.
Fuller now, pushed down to long off for a single.
On the pads. Regis Chakabva comes inside the line of the ball and turns it to square leg for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Shorter and on middle. Chakabva reverse sweeps it, doesn't hit it hard and helps it along the ground towards backward point for a boundary.
Two taken! Slower one now, on middle. Sean Williams turns it with gentle hands to square leg and bags a couple. Good running.
Darted on the pads, Chakabva tucks it to square leg and rotates the strike.
Slight full, on off, eased down to long off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Regis Chakabva drives it to deep cover for one more.
Angles it on the pads, this is flicked to short fine leg.
Slower,short and angling on off, pushed to covers.
A flatter and slightly shorter delivery on off. Sean Williams looks to cut but is cramped for room and gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Drifting on the pads. Regis Chakabva works it behind square on the on side for a single.
A carrom ball this time! Fuller on middle. Regis Chakabva looks to defend but get an outside edge towards the off side.
A fuller delivery on off. Sean Williams eases it to dwon to long off for a single.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Sean Williams blocks this off the front foot.
A fuller delivery on middle. Regis Chakabva pushes it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery around leg. Sean Williams clips it to deep square leg and gets a couple. A slight misfield there allows the batters to come back for the second.
Slower in the air on off. Regis Chakabva defends it towards the off side and takes a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Sean Williams pushes it to long on for a single.

SAFE! Mendis darts this on middle and leg. Sean Williams looks to reverse sweep it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire though is unmoved and Sri Lanka decide to not take a review. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball was going over the stunps.  So a good call to not take a review by Sri Lanka.
A fuller delivery on off. Sean Williams defends it towards the off side.
A fuller delivery on middle. Regis Chakabva drives it to long off for a single.

SIX! Short ball and Sean Williams deposits it over the fence! A good short ball angling into the body. Sean Williams pulls this as he sits back in his crease and the ball goes off the top edge and sailing over the deep square leg fence.
A length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva steers it to third man for a single.
A slower full ball, around off. Sean Williams drives it right of mid off for a single.  The fielder runs across and there is a slight fumble there but no damage done.
Back of a length, on off. Sean Williams goes deep in his crease and works it to mid on again.
A length ball from 'round the wicket on off. Sean Williams works it to mid on.
Pradeep goes short on off. Regis Chakabva pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Another single to end the over. A slower fuller delivery on off. Regis Chakabva is happy to push it to long off and take another single.
Loppy delivery on off. Sean Williams drives it to long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Regis Chakabva eases it down to long off for a single.
Darted on the pads. Sean Williams works it behind square on the on side for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Regis Chakabva works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Touch fuller, on off. Sean Williams knocks it to point for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to upper cut it but misses. Good over by Nuwan Pradeep. Only two runs from it.
A length ball, around off. Sean Williams square drives it to deep cover for a single.
A length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva lets the ball come to him and just opens the face of his blade to  backward third man for a single.
Three dots in a row! A good-length delivery outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to push it towards the off side away from his body but misses.
Pradeep goes slightly shorter on off. Regis Chakabva blocks it out back to the bowler.
A length ball, on off. Regis Chakabva defends it towards the off side.
Sean Williams walks in at number 4 and Nuwan Pradeep is back into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! The skipper departs and another spinner gets a wicket in his first over. The pitch is flat but the cracks are working in the favor of spinners. Really good bowling here. This one is coming with the angle. It stays a touch low as well. Craig Ervine has a poke away from the body and leaves a big gap between the bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and disturbs the stumps. Timely wicket for Sri Lanka, Zimbabwe were running away with the momentum.
Full ball, angling on the pads, swept to short fine leg. Dinesh Chandimal does really well there to dive and save a certain boundary. The fielders around come towards him and gives a pat on his back.
A low full toss, flicked to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Short and way outside off. Left alone.
A fumble in the deep and a single is stolen! Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover here the fielder takes his eyes off the ball and the fumble allows a couple of runs.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller ball, slower in the air and outside off, Chakabva hits it to cover.
Kamindu Mendis is into the attack now.
Fifty for Regis Chakabva! A fine knock from the opener and playing at a brisk rate as well. Slower and on off. He guides it to cover for a quick single.  He will look to convert this into a big one.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single. Momentum with Zimbabwe now.
Leg bye! Darts it on the pads. This one goes off it and towards the leg side for a leg bye.
FOUR! 100 up for Zimbabwe! Full and outside off. Chakabva sweeps it wide of the fielder at deep square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and outside off. Regis Chakabva dabs it to short third man. Played nicely but failed to beat the man there.
SIX! BANG! Converts this full ball into a full toss as Chakabva comes down the track and smashes it over long on for a biggie.
Two more! Making full use of the long boundaries! Darted on the pads. This is hit to deep backward square leg for a brace.
Drifts this one on middle. Craig Ervine pushes off the inner half back to the bowler.
This one comes with the angle. Craig Ervine pushes it to covers.
Strays it on the pads. Ervine wrists it wide of square leg for another couple.
Slower one now, on middle. Blocked out on the leg side.
Tossed up, angling on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Maheesh Theekshana (3.0-0-10-0) is back into the attack.
FOUR! Freebie! Boundary to end the over! Short ball, angling down. Regis Chakabva slaps it past short fine leg and it races away to the fence.
Flatter and on off, Chakabva guides it to backward point.
Good running! A flighted ball, on middle. Regis Chakabva tucks it to square leg and takes a quick couple. Runs the second one hard and makes his ground in time.
Tossed up, on middle. Craig Ervine leans and flicks it to square leg. The fielder there fumbles but just a single.
A loopy ball, on  off. Regis Chakabva drills it down to long off for a single.
On middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
Short of a length, on off. Craig Ervine pulls it to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his left and stops it. Maiden then.
Fuller again, on off, driven nicely but to the fielder at covers. Another dot.
The umpire has warned the bowler for running in the danger area on the pitch on his followthrough.
Length and on off. Ervine pushes it to covers. Good over so far.
On middle, length ball, Craig pushes it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, on off, tapped to point.
Length ball, outside off. Ervine mistimes his push back on the deck.
A fuller delivery on middle. Craig Ervine works it to long on for a single.
Nice loopy delivery on off. Craig Ervine defends it towards the off side.
Craig Ervine walks out at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Jeffrey Vandersay strikes in his first over! Zimbabwe lose their first wicket. This is a googly from Jeffrey Vandersay on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano gets forward and looks to defend. He misses the ball and it hits his pads. There is a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger slowly and Sri Lankan players rejoice. They needed this breakthrough and the spinner has provided it. Takudzwanashe Kaitano thinks of reviewing it but then walks back to the pavilion. Takudzwanashe Kaitano has played a handy knock on his debut.
FOUR! A thick edge and another boundary! A fuller delivery outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano goes for another drive. He gets the thick outside edge and a noundary towards backward third man.

DROPPED! Another chance goes begging! A fuller delivery outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano drives it uppishly towards covers and the fielder there fails to pouch it. Pathum Nissanka is the fielder there and Sri Lanka have been quite poor on the field today.
Tossed up outside off. Regis Chakabva hits this firmly to long off for a single.
Jeffrey Vandersay is into the attack.
A length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva steers it to third man for a single. He will retain the strike.
WIDE! Chamika Karunaratne goes for a yorker but misses the line. A yorker length delivery but down the leg side. Regis Chakabva looks to clip it but misses. Wide called.
This time he finds the gap! A shorter length delivery outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano cuts it straight to pint fielder this time.
A length ball,outside off. Regis Chakabva steers it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Another short ball but firmly hit by Regis Chakabva! A shorter length delivery on off. Regis Chakabva goes deep in his crease and pulls it to backward square leg for a boundary. This has been a solid start.
A short ball on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano pulls it to backward square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano pushes at it away from his body. A single is taken towards third man.
WIDE! An off-pace delivery but going down the leg side. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to clip it but misses.
A length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva steers it to third man for a single.
This is fuller on middle. Regis Chakabva works it to mid-wicket now.
A fuller delivery outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano drives it to sweeper cover for another single.
Shorter length delivery outside off. Regis Chakabva cuts it uppishly and the ball goes off the bounce to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! A wild hoick but safe and another boundary for Zimbabwe. Back of a length, around off. Regis Chakabva skips down the track and swings across the line. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies away towards the third man fence.
A length ball, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano steers it left of point. Kamindu Mendis there dives and stops it.
A very full delivery on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano digs it out towards the leg side.

Chamika Karunaratne has a go at the bowler! A slightly shorter delivery around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to pull but the ball bounces less that he anticipated and misses. The ball goes through to the keeper.
A length ball, on off. Slightly slower in pace. Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it towards the point off the front foot.
A length ball, skidding off the pitch on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it out.
A length ball, on middle. Regis Chakabva works it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, on off. Regis Chakabva defends it with soft hand towards the off side for a single. Good start for Zimbabwe.
A length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva steers it wide of  point and gets a couple towards backward point.
Shorter length outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano upper cuts it to third man for a single.
A length ball, on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano solidly blocks it out.
FOUR! Glorious shot! 50 up for Zimbabwe and this opening pair is looking good. This is full on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano leans foward and drives it left of mid off in the gap for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva steers it to third man for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A length ball, on middle. Regis Chakabva works it behind square on the on side for a single.

Regis Chakabva charges down the track to this length ball around middle and leg. He goes for a big heave across the line but misses. Dot ball. Chamika Karunaratne has some talking to do with the batter.
FOUR! Top edge and a boundary! A good short ball on middle. Regis Chakabva goes for the pull he gets the top edge. The ball flies towards fine leg and a boundary.
Angling into middle and leg. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to pull but misses. The ball hits his thigh pad and rolls towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
He hits the length hard and bowls this on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it towards the leg side by going deep in his crease.
Back of a length, on off. Regis Chakabva works it to square leg for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is into the attack now.
A full ball, almost a yorker, on middle. Kaitano gets his bat down in time.
A full ball, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano swings across the line but misses it completely.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
On a length, on off, this one comes back in. Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it under his eyes and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Around off, on a length, Kaitano keeps it out on the off side.
Length and on off, this is hit to point for a single.
The skipper, Dasun Shanaka is into the attack now.
Full and angling on middle, pushed down to long on for a single to end the over.
Full and on off. Defended off the front foot.
Around off, Kept out on the off side.
Flatter and on off. Blocked out.
Brilliant running! This one drifts back in, on off. Chakabva nudges it with soft hands to square leg and collects a couple of runs.
A slower ball, on middle. Kaitano tucks it to square leg for a single.
Length and on off. Regis Chakabva looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge to point.
Short of a length, on off, Chakabva pulls it nicely but straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
This one shapes away late, outside off. Chakabva shoulders arms to it.
Bangs a short ball, on middle. Chakabva misses his hook.
On middle, tucked away to square leg.
Length and on middle, defended with soft hands.
Another fuller delivery on middle. Regis Chakabva eases it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Regis Chakabva pushes it to mid off.
A quicker delivery on middle. Regis Chakabva blocks it out.
Maheesh Theekshana fires this on leg. Takudzwanashe Kaitano skips down the track and looks to clip it but almost misses it. Gets a faint part of his blade to short fine leg for a single.
Another flatter and quicker ball on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it towards the on side.
A flatter delivery on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano works it to mid-wicket.
A  length ball, on off. Chakabva blocks it off.
Beaten! A good-length delivery around off. Regis Chakabva looks to defend it but the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
A length ball, on off. Kaitano steers it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Goes past the first slip fielder again! A length ball, outside off. Kaitano defends it with soft hands. He gets the thick outside edge and the ball fall short of frist slip fielder and goes through for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it solidly.

Ohh..Dropped! A good-length delivery around off. He gets some extra bounce. Regis Chakabva looks to defend it but the ball catches the outside edge of his blade. It goes for Charith Asalanka at first slip but he drops it. A single taken.
On the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket.
On middle. Kept out.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Darted on the pads. Kaitano sweeps it past short fine leg and bags a boundary. He is not letting this loose delivery go in vain. Really good batting.
Tossed up, full and on middle. this is hit to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off. Kaitano guies it to point.
Tossed up, on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
A length ball, on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano steers it to third man and gets a single.
A full delivery on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano drives it through covers and gets the gap this time. Pathum Nissanka runs behind it and cuts it off before the batters run couple.
Chamika Gunasekara is walking off the field and it looks like an hamstring issue. Maheesh Theekshana replaces him.
A length ball, on off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks this off the front foot to point.
Good shot! A fuller delivery around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano drives it crisply but straight to the fielder at covers.
Two now! This is good start for Zimbabwe! Positive one! Full and on off, driven through covers for a couple of runs. The fielder in the deep does well to half-stop it and keep it out.
FOUR! Two in a row! Lucky there though! A full toss, on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano swings it but gets a leading edge past the keeper and towards the third man fence.
FOUR! Short of a length, on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. A late no ball given as Pradeep overstepped.

Two again! Good running between the wickets! This is touch slower and on middle. Regis Chakabva looks to paddle it across but miscues it past the keeper and towards fine leg for a couple of runs. 8 runs from the debutant's first over.
TWO WIDES! Angles this one down the leg side. Kaitano misses his flick. The keeper dives to his left but fumbles and a single is taken.
Another full length ball, outside off. Kaitano hits it to covers.
Swing and a miss! Fuller length ball, outside off. Kaitano looks to drive but misses.

An appeal for LBW but not given! A length ball, around middle and nipping back in. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was hit high on the pads.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Short, and wide outside off. Kaitano frees his arms and slaps it uppishly over point for a boundary. First boundary in ODIs for Takudzwanashe Kaitano.
On a length, around off, this one jags back in, Kaitano stays back and blocks it out.
Chamika Gunasekara, the debutant will share the new ball with Nuwan Pradeep.
Just a single to start the proceedings then! Good start from Sri Lanka! This is on a length and outside off. Chakabva taps it on the off side.
This one shapes away, on a length, outside off. Chakabva leaves it alone.
Around off, on a length. Chakabva nudges it to mid on.
Length ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Zimbabwe and Takudzwanashe Kaitano are off the mark! Good running! On a length, on off. Kaitano defends it towards cover and scampers across for a quick single.
Pradeep starts with a full ball, hint of shape there, around off. Kaitano blocks it out.

We are all set for the action but before that, both the teams line up for their respective national anthems. It is Zimbabwe's first followed by Sri Lanka's. Both the umpires are on the field. Sri Lankan players stride out to the middle now. Zimbabwe openers, Regis Chakabva and Takudzwanashe Kaitano are out there in the middle as well. Nuwan Pradeep to start with the ball for Sri Lanka. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Farveez Maharoof in his pitch report says that the pitch looks very dry and usually there is live grass on this pitch but not today. He adds that the pitch looks hard and has a lot of cracks. He reckons that once the new ball loses its shine the spinners will be handy on this pitch but overall it is good for batting.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper says that they would have batted first as well. He adds that they had done good preparation from the last week and during the LPL. He informs that they have five changes from the last time they played an ODI. He adds that Chamika Gunasekara will make his debut.

Craig Ervine, the Zimbabwe Skipper, says that they will bat first and make use of good batting conditions. He adds that they need to get through the initial new-ball spell. He mentions that it took two-three days to get used to the conditions and guys are now accustomed and ready to go. He informs that Takudzwanashe Kaitano will debut.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Ryan Burl, Sikandar Raza, Sean Williams, Regis Chakabva (WK), Tendai Chatara, Craig Ervine (C), Takudzwanashe Kaitano, Wesley Madhevere, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Kusal Mendis, Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Kamindu Mendis, Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Jeffrey Vandersay, Chamika Gunasekara, Nuwan Pradeep.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and elected to BAT first!

Zimbabwe, on the other hand, have experienced players like Craig Ervine, Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza in their unit. These three will have to play a crucial role in guiding other young players in the absence of their head coach, Lalchand Rajput. There is enough young talent in this Zimbabwe unit that can shine at the highest level and if they can play to their potential then we can expect a fascinating contest between two exciting sides. Can Zimbabwe bring their A-game to the table and beat Lankan lions on their home turf? Or will Sri Lanka start with a win? We shall find out. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

Sri Lanka have made quite a few changes to their team from the last time they played an ODI series. They are missing the services of some of their key players but have enough talent at their disposal to dominate in their home conditions. The return of talented Kusal Mendis will definitely boost their batting order. This series is also a great platform for some of the talented youngsters to further magnify their stocks and to start a new chapter in Sri Lankan cricket.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI of this three-match ODI series between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. This series provides an opportunity for both these teams to grab some crucial ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup Super League points. Sri Lanka are playing on their home turf and will start as favourites. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, have enough arsenal to challenge Lankan Lions and it will be interesting to see how they apply themselves in Lankan conditions.
